title: 第17章 叫凡哥第18章 小偷是只猴
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
错觉？
听了会，没听到什么动静，苏凡就收回目光，捡起两个储物袋，略微检查了下。
果然。
一人就有三四十枚灵石，加起来也就七八十枚，还有六枚疗伤丹。
“这赵宇请人办事，都不给酬劳的吗？”
苏凡皱着眉头。
想了想，估计是这两人，舔着去巴结赵宇，免费当苦力。
这就是个教训啊，不能当舔狗。
“啊……”
对岸丛林，突然又响起惨叫声。
比之前，更大声。
苏凡清楚听到，还真有人在对面山川厮杀，收起两个储物袋，一跃而起，落在河对面。
河流也就四五米宽，凭他现在的修为，完全可以轻松越过。
很快。
一个山谷出现在前方。
有刺耳的辱骂声。
苏凡轻手轻脚的跑过去，躲在山谷入口外，探头看向里面。
两个青年壮汉，站在山谷里。
一个圆滚滚的胖子，满身鲜血的躺在地上，苍白的脸上充满愤怒和绝望。
“原来是他。”

苏凡恍然点头。
李有德。
那个在决斗场开设赌盘，并大赚一笔的胖子。
“死肥猪，继续跑啊，看你今天能跑到哪里去？”
两个壮汉恶狠狠的瞪着李有德。
身上也有很重的伤。
尤其是左边那人，背上有三条刀伤深可见骨，鲜血止不住的往外冒。
“一打二，还能重伤对方？”
苏凡摸着下巴。
这胖子，还挺有实力的。
但这两人，为什么要对李有德出手？
对了。
杀人夺宝。
李有德在决斗场，赢了不少灵石，这两人肯定是惦记上这些灵石了。
果不其然。
辱骂李有德几句，两人就开始搜身。
慌张无助的李有德，突然察觉到入口外的苏凡，当即便露出求救的小眼神。
苏凡呲牙一笑，才不管这档子破事，转身静悄悄离去。
心急如焚的李有德，眼珠子一转，扯着嗓子大吼：“赵宇这个杂碎是缩头乌龟吗？自己不敢来，让你们来？”
“赵宇！”

苏凡双目微微一眯，缓缓停下脚步，转身看向山谷里两个壮汉。
content_en:
illusion?
After listening for a while and not hearing any movement, Su Fan withdrew his gaze, picked up two storage bags, and checked them briefly.
really.
Each person has thirty or forty spirit stones, which adds up to seventy or eighty, and six healing pills.
"Zhao Yu asks people to do things, but doesn't he even pay them?"
Su Fan frowned.
After thinking about it, I guess it was these two people who wanted to curry favor with Zhao Yu and work as free coolies.
This is a lesson, don’t be a licker.
"Ah..."
In the jungle on the other side, screams suddenly sounded again.
Louder than before.
Su Fan clearly heard that there were really people fighting in the mountains and rivers across the way. He put away the two storage bags, jumped up and landed on the other side of the river.
The river is only four or five meters wide. With his current cultivation level, he can easily cross it.
soon.
A valley appears ahead.
There were harsh insults.
Su Fan ran over lightly, hid outside the entrance of the valley, and looked inside.
Two young strong men stood in the valley.
A round, fat man lay on the ground covered in blood, his pale face full of anger and despair.
"It turned out to be him."
Su Fan nodded suddenly.
Li Youde.
The fat man who opened a betting market in the duel arena and made a fortune.
"You fat pig, keep running. Let's see where you can go today?"
The two strong men stared at Li Youde fiercely.
There were also serious injuries on his body.
Especially the man on the left had three stab wounds on his back that were so deep that the bones were visible, and blood couldn't stop pouring out.
"One versus two, can you still seriously injure the opponent?"
Su Fan touched his chin.
This fat man is quite powerful.
But why did these two people take action against Li Youde?
Right.
Kill people and seize treasures.
Li Youde won a lot of spiritual stones in the duel field. These two people must be thinking about these spiritual stones.
Sure enough.
After a few insults to Li Youde, the two began to search him.
Li Youde, who was panicking and helpless, suddenly noticed Su Fan outside the entrance, and immediately looked at him asking for help.
Su Fan bared his teeth and smiled, turning around and leaving quietly without caring about this nonsense.
The anxious Li Youde rolled his eyes and shouted at the top of his lungs: "Is this bastard Zhao Yu just shy? He doesn't dare to come, so you guys can come?"
"Zhao Yu!"
Su Fan narrowed his eyes slightly, stopped slowly, turned around and looked at the two strong men in the valley.
